articles.title: Introducing the Google Cloud Developer Plugin for AI Coding Agents
articles.summary: Agent skills reduce context window usage and are straightforward to install. Managing individual skills can be unwieldy, or some skills act alongside other skills.
articles.detail: The plugin enables developers to create custom coding agents that integrate with Google Cloud's AI capabilities. This allows for more efficient development and deployment of AI models.

articles.title: Beyond DMS: Accelerating Migrations SQL Server Logins and Users to Cloud SQL
articles.summary: Google Cloud's Database Migration Service (DMS) helps migrate databases from on-premises or cloud systems to fully managed Cloud SQL instances.
articles.detail: The article provides guidance on replicating SQL Server logins and passwords to Cloud SQL, ensuring a smooth migration process.

articles.title: Spanner: Removing cumulative mutation limits for DML transactions
articles.summary: Google Cloud's Spanner is a no-compromise operational database that provides horizontal scale and always-on availability.
articles.detail: The update removes cumulative mutation limits for DML transactions, enabling more efficient and scalable database operations.

articles.title: Introducing Amazon EBS Volume Clones across AWS accounts
articles.summary: AWS introduces Amazon EBS Volume Clones with cross-account copy, enabling the creation of copies of EBS volumes into other AWS accounts.
articles.detail: This feature allows for more flexibility and control over data management and storage across multiple AWS accounts.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: TLS/SSL certificate and end-to-end TLS encryption support for Azure Functions Flex Consumption
articles.summary: Azure Functions Flex Consumption now supports TLS/SSL certificates, enabling more secure and encrypted data processing.
articles.detail: This feature provides a new site-scoped certificate model, allowing up to 3 private (.pfx) and 3 public (.cer) certificates uploaded directly or imported from Azure Key Vault.

articles.title: NVIDIA Expands AI Infrastructure Capacity in Partnership With Australia’s Data Center Ecosystem
articles.summary: NVIDIA collaborates with Australian data center partners to expand land, power, and shell capacity for AI compute infrastructure.
articles.detail: This partnership aims to support the nation's growing demand for AI computing, with a planned buildout of up to 2-gigawatts by 2027.

articles.title: Cisco and Axis Communications: Greater visibility, scalability, and incident management
articles.summary: Cisco and Axis Communications integrate their technologies to provide centralized visibility and simplified operations for physical security.
articles.detail: This integration enables the management of Axis devices directly via the Meraki dashboard, unifying IT and physical security operations.

articles.title: Now generally available: See how Stack Automation by Quali cuts deployment time
articles.summary: Stack Automation by Quali, co-developed with Cisco, automates infrastructure deployment and reduces manual effort.
articles.detail: This solution enables faster deployment times and streamlined operations for data center infrastructure.

articles.title: Google Cloud grows 82% last quarter, putting Amazon and Microsoft investors on notice
articles.summary: Google Cloud revenue surges 82%, outpacing AWS and Azure, reshaping the cloud infrastructure landscape.
articles.detail: This growth signals Google Cloud's increasing competitiveness in the market and its focus on AI-fueled growth.

articles.title: Microsoft CFO Touts AI Stack, Azure Efficiency and Agent Growth at Goldman Conference
articles.summary: Microsoft's CFO highlights the company's broad technology stack, enterprise relationships, and focus on trust.
articles.detail: The article emphasizes Microsoft's position in the market, with its Azure cloud platform and AI capabilities driving growth.

articles.title: 3 AI Optical Networking Stocks Positioned for the Data Center Buildout
articles.summary: Ciena beats Q3 earnings estimates, and demand tied to artificial intelligence, infrastructure modernization, and security supports the company's growth.
articles.detail: The article discusses the growth potential of Ciena, Lumentum, and Coherent in the AI optical networking space.

articles.title: Celero raises $275m to bring coherent optics inside AI data centres
articles.summary: Celero Communications, a chip startup, raises funding to develop processors for pushing data down fibre optic cables between AI chips and racks.
articles.detail: The company's technology aims to support the growing demand for AI computing in data centers.

articles.title: Three insights you may have missed from theCUBE’s coverage of VMware Explore
articles.summary: Private cloud modernization shifts from a virtualization refresh to an operating foundation for production artificial intelligence.
articles.detail: The article discusses key takeaways from VMware Explore, highlighting the growing importance of AI in private cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: What to expect during ‘The AI ROI in Contact Center Summit’: Join theCUBE Sept. 11
articles.summary: Contact center automation now requires measurable results, and enterprises are asking how deployments affect operating costs and service quality.
articles.detail: The article previews the upcoming summit, highlighting the growing importance of measuring AI's impact on contact centers.

articles.title: Could Advanced Micro Devices (AMD)’s Partnership With Cisco Systems (CSCO) Unlock a Massive Middle East AI Opportunity?
articles.description: Microsoft is reshaping its reporting structure to put its AI-fueled growth under the microscope, with Azure revenue finally taking center stage.
articles.summary: Advanced Micro Devices and Cisco Systems partner to build an AI infrastructure in the Middle East.
articles.detail: The article discusses the potential for this partnership to drive growth in the region's AI market.
